title: IIITT@LT-EDI-EACL2021-Hope Speech Detection: There is always Hope in Transformers
reasoning: The paper focuses on classifying social media comments into categories of 'hope speech' or 'not hope speech' as part of a shared task. While it aims to promote positive discourse and mentions religion as a category of hate speech target, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, theological, or ethical frameworks themselves.
